Card data review: the record's own row ended on 31 Aug 2024 (effective_to 2024-08-31). Millennia T&C (published 20 Jul 2026): "Effective 1st September 2024, Wallet loading and EMI transactions will NOT earn Reward Points. Wallet MCC: 6540". A lapsed earning row that could never apply was loaded as info and blocked Verified; removing it changes no result.

Card data review: T&C: "The 5% CashPoints on Uber is eligible for travel/commute related spends ... MCC code of 4121 ... will only be considered"; everything else at Uber falls under "1% cashback on all other spends". This row restated the 1% other-spends rule (same rate, same 1,000 cap) for an 'Uber Eats' merchant the directory cannot resolve, so it loaded as info and blocked Verified. millennia-other-spends-1pct already pays it; removing the row changes no result.

Card data review: T&C: "Effective 1st September 2024, Education payments made through third-party apps will NOT earn Reward Points ... Education MCCs: 8211,8220,8241,8244,8249,8299"; the fee note says apps "like (but not limited to) CRED, PayTM, Cheq, MobiKwik and others". The app condition made the row info, so app-paid education earned 1% (over-statement); SMS spends never carry the platform. Restated as an exclusion on the education category and these MCCs (D20a rows). Direct school/college payments, which do earn per the T&C, are now under-stated (H2).
